note: Track hearing-changes (theory-ear), step 2, on the ear game asked for chord changes (interval-ears, kind change) at its level 1, a number, which is exactly this step: the backing track plays the two changes in C with the chord boxes to check against, then the game plays the 1 chord and the 4 or the 5 in a new key each time and checks the answer. The answers are named as the buttons show them, with the plain word beside each.

exercise.title: Name the second chord: the 4 or the 5
exercise.why: The game plays the 1 chord first every time, so you hear the second chord as a move away from home, and that move sounds the same in every key.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the backing track in C: C and F take turns, then C and G. Watch the lit chord box, and call out 4 on every F and 5 on every G.
Listen for how F moves away from C, and how G pulls back to it.

Press Start in the game below to hear two chords: the 1 chord, then the 4 or the 5, in a new key each time. Pick IV for the 4 chord or V for the 5 chord.
Press Replay below to hear the two chords again before you pick. Press Next for two new chords.
Keep going until you know the answer before the second chord has faded.
